provenance.method: Reviewed DfT accessible-information regulations guidance on 2026-09-05; implementation/exemptions retained.

name: DfT — accessible information on local bus and coach services
description: Government guidance on audible and visible information requirements for local bus and coach services.
intended_use: Inspect onboard accessible-information requirements relevant to planning travel when spoken/visual stop information matters.
audience_or_context: Great Britain — England, Scotland and Wales; local bus/coach services subject to Accessible Information Regulations, with exemptions and implementation conditions.
limitations: Not every vehicle/service is covered identically and exemptions/timescales matter.
A legal requirement does not prove a specific vehicle will be functioning correctly on a particular journey.
